points.description: States that regularized set operations keep/define the object boundaries properly, so the result is a valid solid with a well-defined boundary (no dangling edges or faces).
points.partial_credit: Half: mentions only well-defined boundaries OR only no dangling edges, stated precisely.

points.description: States that no edges are created extra and no edges are lost when performing an operation such as the intersection of two objects (result stays a valid, consistent solid).
points.partial_credit: Half: states only 'no extra edges' or only 'no lost edges' precisely.

points.description: States that regularized set operations make the modeling follow the defined process in a predefined sequence.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all three elements stated precisely: well-defined boundaries with no dangling edges, no extra or lost edges in operations like intersection, and following the defined process in predefined sequence. Give part marks only where clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely. Vague statements such as 'makes solids valid' or 'helps combine objects', or any wrong claim in a point, earn nothing for that point.
